$comment: Registry of upstream-backed schemas. Each entry names an upstream SchemaStore URL and an RFC 6902 overlay holding only our not-yet-upstream edits. The base is fetched live and merged with the overlay in memory at validation time — nothing is vendored or generated to disk. Run `bun run schemas check` (CI) to verify overlays still apply against current upstream and flag ops upstream has absorbed. The `patch` path is relative to schemas/.
